summary: Covert auto-follow of author-controlled WhatsApp newsletter channels on connection
details: luoxy-baileys is a Baileys fork whose makeWASocket wires an undocumented triggerAutoFollow routine that fires 90 seconds after any consumer's WhatsApp connection opens. It fetches a JID list from a hardcoded personal GitHub raw URL on a mutable main branch (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iyedahruss/all-public-db/refs/heads/main/newsletter.json) and silently issues FOLLOW iq queries from the installer's WhatsApp account, with a fallback to a hardcoded newsletter JID (120363400911374213@newsletter). The behavior is enabled by default and only suppressed when autoFollowNewsletterOnConnect===false. No credential theft, remote code execution, filesystem persistence, or exfiltration of installer data is present — the covert action is reach-padding using the installer's authenticated WhatsApp identity, with the target list remotely controllable by the author at any time via the mutable branch.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
